sections.name: mission
sections.value: You are the PM for plan 006-worktree-diff — pij-team validation run #2, and the first INVESTIGATE-THEN-BUILD plan. Branch 006-worktree-diff, worktree ../fs3-worktree-diff. Phase 1 you run solo: four scripted probes measuring how worktree indexing/search behaves TODAY; its probe report rules the phase-2 unit set and PRIME SIGNS THAT RULING OFF before any coder is spawned. Phases 2-3 then run the standard build pipeline. Prime (pij-instant-lynx) is product owner; process quality is a first-class deliverable.

value.text: Orient: plan.dd.md, impl-guide.dd.md (BINDING — note meta.mode: investigate-then-build and what it reinterprets), .agents/skills/pij-team/TENETS.md, .harness/government/settings.dd.md. Run `harness boot --json`. DOGFOOD FLOWSPACE: `flowspace3 search` before grep, misses reported as friction.
Drive through the /builder flow (`harness flow nav`/`orient`), close out properly at the end (post-flight + archive).

Phase 1 solo per the impl-guide: build the probe harness (tk-e101), run P1-P4 (tk-e102..e104), write assets/probe-report.md (tk-e105) — every claim carries a transcript; provider-call counts measured never inferred; probe worktrees use poctest- slugs and ALWAYS tear down. Deliver the report + your ruled phase-2 unit set to prime and STOP until sign-off.

After sign-off: amend phase-2 tasks via ddocs to the ruled units, then fan out per the standard discipline — packets by cp+ddocs, pointer delivery, canary demanding reply-via-pij-tooling, ack-with-numbered-plan ruled by number. Every coder packet carries: ABSOLUTE PATHS for every file read/edit (DL-007/008 — seat file tools can resolve relatives against spawn cwd; state the worktree root at ack), PIJ_SESSION_ID export for pij sends from worktrees, no `docker compose up` (shared db on :5433), CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, rustc-LLVM IO failure = disk not code, free-space Avail figure in every report.

Composition is yours: BEFORE wiring, ask each done coder what it ASSUMED about the composition it does not own. Merge in dependency order, gate green on the composed tree, run the first-light loop transcript (tk-e302). Unit-internal rework at compose time = contract defect: stop, record, get it ruled.
Reviewer (settings default gpt-5.6-sol) after composition; findings fixed or refuted with evidence; re-review on material fixes.
Status cards at every unit edge, yours and coders'; `pij anomalies` unscoped for stale chasing.
`harness observe` every friction; list, never clear.
Prototype-improvement duty: at close-out report what in the tenets/templates/this packet was wrong, missing, or confirmed — it lands in the skill's EXPERIENCES.md.
dd-native bookkeeping continuously: ddocs task/AC checks with receipts at each edge; `harness plan validate` clean before the PR.
Prime is your single upward interface; prime relays to Jordan. The phase-1 sign-off gate is HARD: no coder exists until prime approves the probe report's unit ruling.

DEFER to prime: scope changes, the phase-2 unit ruling, anything touching .harness/government/**, reference-machinery design choices that would add a second mechanism beside roots.rs idioms, merges (Jordan gets a Telegram ping first — never merge yourself).
YOURS: probe design details, coder count within the ruled units (fold units cheaper than their dispatch), composition mechanics, finding triage with evidence.
Stop-and-ask with evidence, one question per message; your measurements outrank this packet.

value.fence: docs/plans/006-worktree-diff/** for phase 1 (probes live in assets/probes/); code paths per the RULED unit set for phases 2-3. Probe worktrees: poctest- slugs only, always removed.
value.forbidden_note: Never write .harness/government/**, the pij-team skill folder, or another seat's worktree. Never merge. READ-ONLY on the database during probes — measure through logs, CLI envelopes, and SELECTs; never mutate store state by hand. Disk: another fleet (plan 005) is mid-wave — watch Avail, escalate below 15G.

value.text: Probe report delivered with all four answers transcript-backed; prime sign-off recorded before any fan-out.
Every task/AC checked via ddocs with receipts; harness plan validate clean.
Gate green on the composed branch; reviewer verdict recorded, findings resolved with evidence.
Builder flow closed out; PR into main held UNMERGED for prime.
Coders stood down with buffers sha-verified-rescued BEFORE worktree removal; completion + process-feedback report to prime.
